baseline: sequential climatology (Laplace running base rate, per domain per seed).
conditions: changing_rule v1.0.0, InstrumentedArchB (additive subclass of arch_b; PredictionLog JSONL byte-identical to ArchB on throwaway seed 73210 -> instrumentation behaviorally inert), affect=none, 10 eps x 4 fresh seeds {73205,73206,73208,73209}, PredictionLog JSONL + sidecar JSONL per seed. 1560 ticks/domain. Estimator feature_mode='B' (causal prequential replay).

config.estimator: competence_estimator.CompetenceEstimator variant B feature_mode='B' (+novelty features), normalized SGD eta_p=0.1/eta_e=0.05

hypothesis: Adding the agent's prediction-time novelty/state context (mean_similarity, n_nbrs, retrieval_used, e1_ema) via the additive InstrumentedArchB sidecar couples the causal online estimator to error magnitude: Brier beats climatology on >=3/4 domains AND corr(predicted_uncertainty,|actual_error|)>=0.40 on >=3/4.
interpretation: NEGATIVE: neither win gate fires. Brier beats on 2/4 (D2 action_consequence 0.25028 vs 0.25081 -- CALIBRATED verdict, razor-thin; D4 retrieval_usefulness 0.24890 vs 0.24997 -- marginal; D1 0.25288 vs 0.25107 and D3 0.09704 vs 0.09674 LOSE). Coupling corr(uncertainty,|err|): 0.049/0.089/0.048/-0.040 -- 0/4 reach 0.40. Novelty features ARE load-bearing (novelty-zeroed ablation worsens Brier on D1/D2/D3) but gains are tiny. Mechanism (measured): the cue channels of the obs vector are pure RNG (cue redrawn uniform each tick) and contribute 60.5% of total |err| variance; batch-OLS ceiling with ALL features: R^2=0.029 on total error (corr ceiling 0.17), R^2=0.078 on predictable channels (corr ceiling 0.28). A perfect predictor of the predictable component caps at corr 0.629 with total error. The 0.40 target on total-error as defined is therefore extremely hard; variant B reaches ~30% of the batch-oracle ceiling. Kill arms: anchor-only reproduces climatology to 1e-9 (PASS); error-permutation intact<permuted on D1/D2/D4. Next: variant C (EXP-FP-0072) uses channel-decomposed REST error features (rest-channel lag-2 autocorr 0.24 vs total 0.13) -- the cue noise was masking learnable structure in the feature channel.
limitations: Single env (changing_rule), closed-loop; affect=none; PROTOTYPE replay status; anchor means early ticks equal baseline (pooled prequential Brier includes transient honestly).
null_hypothesis: The novelty features carry no competence information (variant B is theater too).
preregistered_metric: Per-domain Brier_est vs Brier_climo; corr coupling gate >=0.40; ECE/MCE reported. Preregistered: experiments/preregistration_EXP-FP-0071.json (sealed pre-run).
